HF-064-03: --self-test is wall-clock-flaky; its determinism check drops only the top-level generated_at so provenance.generated_at can differ between the two compared runs. K6 proves the mechanism; K7 measured 1 failing run in 40 (final 7-run sample 6/7). The claimed 'self-test 21/21' is not a deterministic fact. Repair: exclude provenance.generated_at from the key or inject a fixed clock

findings.finding: --self-test writes fixed-name temp files into the canonical evaluation/ tree (ROOT/evaluation/_selftest_ablation_dryrun.csv and _selftest_design_dryrun.yaml). K5 (sandbox directory squat) proves the write path and shows the failure mode; concurrent workers share the names and a crash can leave debris. Recommend tempfile.TemporaryDirectory or a caller-supplied scratch dir.

the dry-run CSV is byte-deterministic; the dry-run report is deterministic modulo the top-level and nested generated_at fields. The author labels this correctly; only the self-test key is under-normalised (HF-064-03).

verifier_calls_per_accepted_artifact and human_review_minutes are measured, reported, and disclosed as unmatched design deviations; a token-matched budget cannot equalise them across arms of different accuracy. Design-owner decision (amend or scope note), not a harness defect.

spread_fraction is (max-min)/min (harness _spread), not (max-min)/mean; the convention is the stricter one and the matched verdict is convention-robust on these bytes, but the design text says only '+/-2%'. Recommend documenting the denominator in the next design amendment.
